lines.text: This shrimp punches so hard, water boils.
But the weird part comes after the punch.
Its club swings at about eighty kilometers an hour.
lines.caption: Its club swings at about 80 km/h.

lines.text: And it gets there with up to ten thousand G's.
lines.caption: And it gets there with up to 10,000 G's.

lines.text: So the water in front of it boils into bubbles.
Then the bubbles collapse, with a bang, heat, and a flash of light.
Some have even cracked aquarium glass.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
